g.text: «output matched to an input by Cocos»
Multiplicities are those required by the AMRF SHACL shapes; links without one are not constrained.
(m): only for models, i.e. tools whose schema:featureList includes edam:operation_3482. Recommended: a warning if missing.
schema:encodingFormat is required unless the data is a gene report (edam:data_0916).
The EDAM, ARO and NCBITaxon boxes stand for any subclass of the term shown (rdfs:subClassOf*).
Dashed arrows are not RDF properties: Cocos matches data and inputs by their EDAM data, format and sequencing technique.
